messages:
lina-design: Quick a11y check — noticed weird tabbing 'hop' in Model Details panel. When you open a model and Tab, focus lands on the small caret icon in the header, then jumps past the primary actions (Copy ID, Deploy). Screenshot: https://img.redwood/capture.jpg. Anyone seen this? sam_k: I can repro. Steps? is this on dark theme only? lina-design: Steps: Console > Models list > open row > press Enter to open details panel > press Tab — focus goes to header caret (which toggles collapse) then next Tab skips Copy ID and goes to secondary links. Happens in both themes but uglier in dark. mohit: sounds like DOM order misaligned with visual order. Might be an extra focusable element (caret) inserted before action buttons. Could be tabindex=0 on a non-button element. kevin_m: We intentionally made the header caret keyboard-focusable so keyboard users can collapse panel, but agree it shouldn't come before the primary actions. Two options: reorder DOM so caret is first visually/DOM or make caret part of the header button that toggles collapse (so a single control). Also ensure aria-expanded state is present. access-bot: a11y scan results: low-severity: header caret is focusable separate from the header button; medium-severity: focus ring contrast on .focus-outline in dark theme fails contrast (computed fg #ffffff on ring vs bg #1f1f1f ~ ratio 2.1:1). Recommend meeting WCAG 2.1 AA 3:1 for focus indicators. lina-design: Proposed markup change — combine into one control and use region roles: ```
...actions...
``` This keeps a single focus stop and ARIA announces open/closed. sam_k: +1 for single button. I'll take a small PR to adjust DOM order and update aria attributes. mohit: small note — when panel opens, SR should announce "Model details panel opened" and move focus to first interactive element inside (Copy ID). Use focus management: focus() after animation ends. kevin_m: Agree. Also let's pick a focus ring token for dark theme: recommend outline-color: #9ad3ff at 3px. Keeps visibility without being too bright. lina-design: I'll file the PR with DOM reorder, single toggle button, aria-expanded, + focus management and update the dark theme focus token. @kevin_m please review once it's up. kevin_m: Will review. If we need to ship quickly, keep behavioral changes minimal (no keyboard shortcuts). lina-design: Yep — minimal change and tests. Thanks all :thumbsup:
